title: Demonstrating the accuracy and efficiency of artificial intelligence integrated workflows for primary breast cancer diagnosis: A comparative paired reader analysis

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Demonstrating the accuracy and efficiency of artificial intelligence integrated workflows for primary breast cancer diagnosis: A comparative paired reader analysis》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Evidence on the real-world impact of artificial intelligence (AI) decision support on diagnostic efficiency and workflow outcomes in primary breast cancer pathology remains limited.

evidence.text: Evidence on the real-world impact of artificial intelligence (AI) decision support on diagnostic efficiency and workflow outcomes in primary breast cancer pathology remains limited.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Demonstrating the accuracy and efficiency of artificial intelligence integrated workflows for primary breast cancer diagnosis: A comparative paired reader analysis》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】This retrospective, single-site, paired reader, two-arm study evaluated the impact of AI-assisted digital pathology (DP + AI) versus standard DP on workflow efficiency and diagnostic performance in digitized consecutive breast biopsy cases.

【Abstract · abstract-1-11】Baseline TAT analysis of 3298 cases, independent of study cohort, showed longer TAT for cases requiring immunohistochemistry (IHC; 3.73 days) than for those not requiring (1.17 days).

evidence.text: This retrospective, single-site, paired reader, two-arm study evaluated the impact of AI-assisted digital pathology (DP + AI) versus standard DP on workflow efficiency and diagnostic performance in digitized consecutive breast biopsy cases.
Baseline TAT analysis of 3298 cases, independent of study cohort, showed longer TAT for cases requiring immunohistochemistry (IHC; 3.73 days) than for those not requiring (1.17 days).

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Demonstrating the accuracy and efficiency of artificial intelligence integrated workflows for primary breast cancer diagnosis: A comparative paired reader analysis》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】The mean pathologist overall review time was reduced by 43.5% in DP + AI (40.18 [95% CI: 36.20-44.16] s) versus DP (71.12 [95% CI: 64.39-77.84] s) (p < 0.0001).

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】Diagnostic agreement was 97.42% with DP and 99.48% with DP + AI, with 100% sensitivity observed in the DP + AI workflow.

evidence.text: The mean pathologist overall review time was reduced by 43.5% in DP + AI (40.18 [95% CI: 36.20-44.16] s) versus DP (71.12 [95% CI: 64.39-77.84] s) (p < 0.0001).
Diagnostic agreement was 97.42% with DP and 99.48% with DP + AI, with 100% sensitivity observed in the DP + AI workflow.
